fields.name: SqlConfiguration SQL Server connection-property family
fields.contract: SqlConfiguration exposes one SQL Server connection-property family for choosing application identity and workload, endpoint and catalog, transport and certificate handling, pooling and capacity, execution options, and client identity. Every member is optional: an unset member is not applied when a SQL Server connection string is constructed. Within the Configuration hierarchy, construction applies supplied values from global, shard-set, read/write, shard, and connection-local levels in that order; a later supplied value replaces an earlier one for the same property.
